scenarios.description: Ring of length 4 through two trading firms that are both suppliers and customers.

scenarios.description: Three ledger payments never appear on the bank statement.
Bank debits with no ledger entry (two unexplained ACH debits, one unbooked charge).
Payments cleared 8–11 working days after posting (outside a normal tolerance).
Three ledger payments settled by one bank debit (sum).
One customer deposit settles three sales invoices booked separately.
Bank amount differs from the ledger by a bank fee (+₹590 on a remittance, −₹236 deducted from two receipts).
Ledger says vendor X; the bank shows the money went to an employee's account.
A subgroup whose amounts are spread evenly between ₹7,000 and ₹9,999 (leading digits 7–9 only). Not labelled as fraud: the Benford module must find the deviation.

targets: Benford first-digit subgroup test, MAD band (P7)
